dish.title: Nepali Aloo Tama: Potato, Bamboo Shoot, and Black-Eyed Pea Curry with Rice
dish.description: A tangy, brothy Nepali curry of potatoes, bamboo shoots, and black-eyed peas simmered with tomatoes, ginger, garlic, turmeric, and fenugreek seeds tempered in oil until fragrant. Served over basmati rice with cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Nepali Aloo Tama: Potato, Bamboo Shoot, and Black-Eyed Pea Curry with Rice
recipe_version.description: A tangy, brothy Nepali curry of potatoes, bamboo shoots, and black-eyed peas simmered with tomatoes, ginger, garlic, turmeric, and fenugreek seeds tempered in oil until fragrant. Served over basmati rice with cilantro.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice. Cut the potatoes, drain and rinse the bamboo shoots and cut into strips, and drain and rinse the black-eyed peas. Chop the onion and tomatoes, mince the garlic, grate the ginger, slit the chiles, and chop the cilantro.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 12 minutes; then rest covered off the heat 10 minutes. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Temper and build the masala
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 5-quart Dutch oven over medium. Add the fenugreek and cumin seeds and cook until the fenugreek turns one shade darker, about 30 seconds. Add the onion and cook until soft, about 6 minutes; add the garlic, ginger, and chiles for 1 minute, then the turmeric and chili powder. Add the tomatoes and cook until soft, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Brown the potatoes and bamboo
steps.body: Add the potatoes and bamboo shoots and stir to coat in the masala, 3 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add 3 cups water, the black-eyed peas, and 1 3/4 tsp salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered until the potatoes are tender and starting to break, about 18 minutes. Press a few potato chunks against the pot to thicken the broth slightly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice. Ladle the aloo tama into bowls beside or over the rice and scatter cilantro.
